risk_name: AML triage model deployed without SR 11-7 validation
current_control: Model in pilot only; not in production AML decision
regulatory_implication: OCC examination finding; potential MRA if deployed without validation
notes: Risk escalates if business pressure leads to production deployment before MRM slot available (Q3 2026 earliest)

risk_name: Workday Illuminate (AI) processing HR data without formal risk assessment
current_control: Default-on feature; no data governance review completed
regulatory_implication: CFPB: AI in employment decisions (if extended to performance); EEOC: bias in AI-assisted HR
notes: 14,200 employees interacting with AI tool with no formal approval, no bias assessment, no usage telemetry. Requires immediate data governance review.

risk_name: SAP Joule inadvertently re-enabled via SAP update
current_control: CFO directive to disable; no technical enforcement
regulatory_implication: SR 11-7 if Joule used for financial modeling; OCC MRA for unvalidated model in regulatory reporting workflow
notes: Joule disabled by config but SAP updates can re-enable features. Technical control (feature flag lockdown) not yet implemented. Next SAP update scheduled Q3 2026.

risk_name: GitHub Copilot generating code with embedded API keys or PII
current_control: DLP policy on code repos; Copilot telemetry reviewed monthly
regulatory_implication: GLBA safeguards; PCI DSS if payment card data in generated code
notes: DLP scanning in place; one near-miss in Q1 2026 (developer hardcoded test credential, caught by DLP). No breach. Monthly review cadence adequate.

risk_name: Salesforce Einstein Retail scoring using inputs that proxy for protected class
current_control: Conditional: credit data excluded from Einstein input
regulatory_implication: CFPB ECOA; potential fair lending examination finding if proxy variables present
notes: CFPB examination readiness review pending; Einstein input features not fully audited for proxy risk. Fair lending impact assessment required before next exam.

risk_name: 12 production AI models operating past SR 11-7 validation expiry
current_control: Model inventory tracking; MRM review slots requested
regulatory_implication: Federal Reserve SR 11-7; OCC MRA if identified in examination; blocks AML and credit AI scale
notes: This is the most material AI governance risk at First Capital. 12 tier-1 models overdue for validation. MRM team has 7-month backlog. FCF-INIT-012 is the remediation path.

risk_name: AI-generated SAR narratives not reviewed before filing
current_control: Policy: AI-assisted drafts require human review before FinCEN submission
regulatory_implication: BSA/AML: inaccurate SAR = criminal liability; FinCEN examination finding
notes: Policy and system controls in place. Human review required for all AI-assisted SARs. Monitoring for control drift as AML triage scales.

risk_name: M365 Copilot summarizing confidential client communications in Teams
current_control: DLP policy restricts certain channels; Copilot excluded from client-facing Teams channels
regulatory_implication: GLBA; CCPA if consumer data; FINRA if wealth advisor channels
notes: Configuration partially complete. Wealth and commercial banker channels not yet fully scoped. Data classification of Teams channels incomplete.
